description: Leb Teso obedo leb Nilotic ma dano milion aryo ki nus loko i tung wokceng me Uganda, i Soroti, Kumi, Serere ki Amuria, ki Iteso me Kenya.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) for the Ateso courses (#131) with low confidence in Ateso; needs a native-speaker review. The Acholi needs a native-speaker review too; word and unit notes fall back to the English notes (lang/en/about/teo).

why.title: Leb me **Soroti, Kumi ki nam me Teso.**
why.text: Leb Teso tye i dog gang pa Ateker ki Leb Karimojong ki Leb Turkana, ci pwonyone yabo yo i leb mapol cakke ki Uganda cito wa Kenya ki South Sudan. Pwonye pi dog gang, wot, tic, ki wer, myel ki lok pa Teso.

cards.title: Pi dog gang
cards.text: Lok ki kwaro ki wat i Soroti ki Kumi.

cards.title: Pi luwot
cards.text: Wot cakke ki Soroti cito wa Kumi, Ngora ki nam Bisina.

cards.title: Pi jo ma mito ngeyo
cards.text: Nong leb Nilotic ma nyinge tye ki kit laco ki dako, ma pe tye ki dul nying.

sample.prompt: Lok mene ma tyen lok ne “apwoyo”?

landing.audience: Jo ma loko Leb Acoli ma gicako manyen, dog gang ma oa ki Teso, ki luwot ma gicito tung wokceng me Uganda.
landing.first: Moto, tito nyingi ki kwan wel, lacen dog gang, cam, cuk, cawa, kabedo, gang ki yot kom, dul ki dul.

cast.emma: Welo ma tye ka pwonye Leb Teso ma peya owoto
